question: When the frozen YOLO proposal is evaluated first and deterministic code is applied second, does any FILUSDT.P 1h model proposal occur on the first close above the six-MA bundle?

owner_authorization.verbatim: 试试看 但是我认为 应该是模型先检测 再代码检测
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Reuse the already-frozen FILUSDT.P 1h holdout artifacts from checkpoint use #17, preserve the YOLO proposals exactly, and apply a preregistered first-close-beyond-six-MA code gate only after each proposal. No network read, new inference, training, tuning, promotion, deployment, messaging, or order action is authorized.

source_exhaustiveness_requirement: The source summary must prove raw_boxes == accepted_structural_boxes == candidate CSV rows, so no raw model proposal is hidden by the old structural gate.
single_variable: Keep the prior run's model pixels, raw boxes, classes, confidence threshold, NMS and endpoints fixed; replace only the completed-history semantic gate with a deterministic first-close-beyond-the-full-six-MA-bundle gate applied after each model proposal.

null_controls.direction_flip: At every unchanged model proposal, mirror LONG to SHORT or SHORT to LONG while retaining time, OHLC, MAs, box and confidence.
null_controls.future_mutation: After each proposal endpoint, multiply all later OHLCV rows by deterministic large factors, recompute MAs, and require the gate decision at the endpoint to remain byte-equivalent within 1e-12.
null_controls.code_only_reference: For diagnosis, list first-close-above-bundle bars between the detected core start and first model endpoint. These references are explicitly pipeline_eligible=false because no model proposal existed there.

decision_contract.success: At least one unchanged YOLO proposal passes the deterministic breakout gate at its own endpoint.
decision_contract.late_model: A code-only first-close reference occurs before the first YOLO proposal and no proposal passes; this diagnoses model-stage latency rather than code-stage latency.
